protocol_description: In this protocol, mice are trained to search for target A, then target B. Then there is a probe where mice are rotated 180 degreees and then evaluated to see if they travel between targets. Entrances are static.

Mouse 111 & 112 comes out from static entrance. Target A. Probe after tRIAL 18. Switch to Target B at Trial 21.Probe2 after trial 29. Barrier trials from Trial 30-34, then Probe 3 at the end. Compressed schedule, up to 6 trials a day. Mouse left in arena for 30min on the last trial of each day.
The males had a total of 44 trials. The females had 29 trials. Both groups did target A, probe 1, target B, probe2.
